title: Liria 05 – Two Sides of a Truth
summary: The marketplace of Novaris was unusually noisy that afternoon.
story:
The marketplace of Novaris was unusually noisy that afternoon.

"This spot has belonged to my stall for years!" an elderly fruit seller shouted, folding his arms.

"And am I supposed to sell my wares in the middle of the street?" a young flower seller retorted indignantly.

Liria, who had just bought an apple, stopped to see what was happening.

"What's going on here?"

"She wants to set up her flower stall right next to mine!" the fruit seller explained. "Then my customers won't be able to get through!"

The flower seller shook her head. "But my flowers wilt in the shade of the houses!"

Liria studied both stalls, then the large fountain in the center of the square.

"May I ask you something?"

Both nodded reluctantly.

"Why do your stalls have to work against each other?"

The merchants stared at her, puzzled.

Liria pointed to the baskets of fruit.

"Your fruit needs shade, doesn't it?"

The man nodded.

"And your flowers need sunshine."

The young woman nodded too.

"Then put the fruit baskets beneath the big awning and the flowers in front. Customers can walk between both stalls."

The fruit seller considered the proposed arrangement.

"We'd even have more room for our wares."

"And the flowers would make the whole stall look beautiful!" the young merchant added enthusiastically.

Before long, they were helping each other rearrange their goods.

Liria watched with satisfaction as the argument gave way to a shared market stall.

"You should work for the city council," the fruit seller joked.

Liria laughed.

"Oh, I think I'd ask far too many questions there!"

She said goodbye with a cheerful wave.

As she continued on her way, she reflected on the encounter.

Not every conflict needed a winner. Sometimes all it took was looking at things from another perspective.
